constraints: count must be greater than 0; if omitted, a single column is inserted.
Inserts columns inside tableName only, not the sheet: the sheet's total column count is unaffected, and data to the right of the table is automatically shifted right.
If tableName does not exist, or there is not enough room in the sheet, the command does nothing.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Inserts one or count empty column(s) into tableName at the specified column index, before or after it per insertAfter.

sentinelValues.meaning: vk table insert before: insert column(s) before column (default if omitted).
vk table insert after: insert column(s) after column.
